scope: Frost Egg portraits with the user-directed saturated palette
generation: Built-in ImageGen edit of final Blender renders

outline.measurement: Opaque artwork boundary to 50% alpha perimeter

portraits.name: Snow Pup
portraits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make one Roblox simulator inventory sticker on fully transparent RGBA. Image 1 is the final vibrant Blender render and must be preserved, including its exact front-left camera, colors, pose, facial features and soft cube proportions. Image 2 is for black outer stroke style only. The subject is Snow Pup: warm cream cube, strong bright sky-blue floppy ears, glossy blue eyes, pink cheeks, tiny paws and one cream curl. Retain the strong saturated hues, dark contrasts and soft 3D shading from Image 1. Add a single extra thick, smooth and uniform solid pure black outer silhouette contour, about 48 px on a 1024 square. Keep the full subject centered with clear transparent margins. No ground shadow, matte, background, pale wash, recolor, internal line art, lettering, graphics, glow, props, cropped parts or extra subjects.
